summary.intent: Execute Phase 50 (IPFS/IPNS Data-Integrity Fixes) of the cipher-box project using wave-based parallel worktree execution across 5 plans covering integer-overflow fixes, refcount-aware drain, subtree IPNS traversal, and unpin integrity fixes.
summary.outcome: Wave 1 (plans 50-01, 50-02, 50-03, 50-05) completed successfully with all 4 worktrees merged to the phase branch, post-merge typecheck clean, and 93/93 targeted tests green. Wave 1 tracking committed; Wave 2 (plan 50-04) not yet dispatched at transcript end.

repo: pnpm/orval api-client generation resolves against the workspace root rather than the active worktree, so any plan that runs `pnpm api:generate` or `pnpm install` leaks generated/regenerated files (131+ api-client files, sdk/client.ts) into the main checkout's working tree.

The pre-commit hook runs `check-api-client.sh` + `pnpm lint-staged` (eslint+prettier across the full api-client output); this is slow enough (~137 files) that the gsd-tools `cleanup-wave` merge helper silently times out or fails its internal commit step, returning `merge_failed` with empty stderr.

`.husky/_/` hook stubs are auto-generated (untracked) in worktrees when `pnpm install` runs there — these block `cleanup-wave` from cleaning a worktree and must be removed before re-running the helper.

The `gsd-tools query init.manager` dep parser mis-parses version-qualified dep strings like 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' into a phantom phase '1.1', marking real deps unsatisfied and suppressing auto-recommendations even when the phase is ready to execute.
Two orphan `worktree-agent-a92edd36` / `worktree-agent-abd7998d` branches exist with no attached worktrees — left from a prior session, not safe to blindly delete without investigation.

The IpfsModule → VaultModule circular import was accepted as-is in plan 50-04 (IN-04); extraction to a shared module was explicitly deferred with cycle-reason comments in IpfsModule, PendingUnpinModule, and VaultModule.

code.finding: Refcount guard added here (plan 50-02): skip physical unpin in drain when CID is re-pinned, fixing WR-03 race where a re-pin during drain caused spurious removal.

New `collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync` function added (plan 50-03) for on-demand fetch+decrypt traversal of unloaded subtrees; 4 deletion call-sites updated to await it, fixing D-03 silent data loss on unloaded folders.
CID field now enforces `@MaxLength(255)` and `@Matches` (CIDv0/CIDv1 regex) per IN-02; api-client regenerated (132 files) as a consequence.

workflow: Never run the full monorepo test suite in parallel from worktree agents — RAM starvation and infra-dependent integration tests make it unsafe. Run targeted test suites (changed packages only) for the post-merge gate instead.

When `gsd-tools cleanup-wave` returns `merge_failed` with empty stderr and leaves `MERGE_HEAD` in place, the merge itself succeeded cleanly — the failure is in the hook-gated commit step. Completing the merge manually with `git commit` (hooks enabled, generous timeout) is the correct recovery path.

Before re-merging after a leaked-file block: verify all dirty working-tree files match the worktree branch exactly (git diff against worktree tip), then `git checkout -- .` to discard them so the merge can proceed cleanly.
macOS (BSD) `mktemp` does not substitute `XXXXXX` in the middle of a template string — place the `XXXXXX` at the end only.

friction: `gsd-tools cleanup-wave` merge helper silently failed mid-wave when the pre-commit hook couldn't complete its internal merge commit — left `MERGE_HEAD` dangling and reported an opaque `merge_failed` with no diagnostic output, requiring manual diagnosis and recovery.

pnpm/orval api-client generation leaked 131 files from the 50-05 worktree into the main checkout after earlier merges triggered post-commit hooks, blocking the subsequent merge until the leaked files were verified and discarded.
`.husky/_/` stubs auto-generated in the 50-05 worktree blocked `cleanup-wave` from processing that worktree; required explicit `git clean -fd .husky/_/` before re-running.
The init.manager dep parser phantom-phase bug suppressed recommendations for Phase 50 even though all real deps were satisfied, requiring manual judgment to proceed.
Bash `mktemp` mid-template `XXXXXX` substitution silently failed (BSD behavior), producing a non-unique temp filename for the wave manifest.
open_items: Wave 2 (plan 50-04, depends on 50-01 + 50-02) not yet dispatched — transcript ends after Wave 1 merge and tracking commit.
Phase 50 verification step (gsd-verify-work / acceptance testing) not yet run.
